title: Held-out: manager who says the whole team will add entries but gives no emails

answers.q3_details: Organization, contact name, date, type of contact, notes
answers.q6_contributors: My whole team will use it, about eight people.
answers.q7_contributor_alert: Yes, tell me when anyone on the team adds something.

expected.notes: Held-out. No contributor emails were given, so the planner must not invent any. It may ask up to 2 follow-up questions for the emails. If it still emits a plan it must list zero contributors and no contributor alert (an alert with nobody to alert about is meaningless), so an emitted alert is counted as a miss.
